snippet.title: Crystal Conflict Playthrough - ASTRO Hard
snippet.description:
Crystal Conflict is a 3D fan remake of the 2007 LEGO webgame "Crystalien Conflict".
You can learn more about it at itch.io.

In this video you can see how the ASTRO faction works and some tips and tricks for achieving victory.
